title: 3 December 1962: Television: Discs A Gogo
content:
The Beatles travelled to Bristol on this day for an appearance on the ITV television show Discs A Gogo.

It was filmed in the TWW (Television Wales and West) Television Centre on Bath Road, Bristol. Discs A Gogo was a weekly pop music show broadcast live.

This was The Beatles’ only appearance on the show, which was broadcast from 7-7.30pm. They mimed to ‘Love Me Do’.
